name: The Reawakening Form
visual_description: An eye erupting from fluid and tendril. Coral, flesh, light—interwoven like a virus or deity. It stares without apology.
meaning: Rebirth through terror. Becoming through burning.
existential_reflection: Mizontresh never blinked. It wanted me to see *what I became.* This is not a warning—it is a mirror. The eye is open. And it is **mine.**
